# naga-invalid-baseline.txt — Tint fixtures that spv2wgsl's IR walker
# currently TRANSLATES but whose WGSL the naga validator REJECTS.
#
# These are PRE-EXISTING feature gaps (not regressions): the IR builder
# produces structurally-plausible WGSL that our own corpus checker
# (`zig build wgpu-diff`) accepts, but full naga validation (the real
# Chrome/Firefox-grade oracle) rejects.  Tracked here so the corpus-naga
# gate (`scripts/naga-validate-tint.sh`) can:
#   - FAIL if a NEW invalid appears (a real regression), and
#   - FAIL if a listed fixture becomes VALID (so we shrink this list
#     instead of letting it rot).
#
# The burn-down families (remove lines as each is fixed):
#   [DONE turn 813] function calls — fixed: void-returning calls now emit
#                             a bare statement, not `let x: = f()`.
#   [DONE turn 813] hoisting into nested — fixed by markHoistedResults:
#                             results used outside their defining block are
#                             hoisted to a function-scope var (assigned at
#                             the def site).  Cleared the whole *Hoisting*
#                             family, switch-hoist, Loop_ContinueUseBodyValue,
#                             and DuplicateTrue_Premerge.
#   [DONE turn 855] vertex-shader struct I/O — direct struct-output cases
#                             fixed turn 813; *_Transitive (output written in a
#                             called helper) fixed turn 855 by emitting SPIR-V
#                             Input/Output as module-scope var<private> (entry
#                             copies inputs->private and private->outputs), so
#                             I/O resolves from any function.
#   [DONE turn 813] switch sint values — fixed: signed (i32) selector case
#                             literals are reinterpreted from their raw word
#                             (4000000000 → -294967296), matching Tint.
#   switch hoist             — branch_Switch_HoistFrom{Case,Default}
#   [DONE turn 813] hoisted-var loop header + phi-cross-block — markHoistedResults
#                             now also scans OpPhi operands (a phi value is used at
#                             its predecessor block); cleared PhiInLoopHeader_*,
#                             Phi_Bug_435621075, Propagated_PropagatedPhiValue_BlockParam.
#   misc                     — branch_BranchConditional_DuplicateTrue_Premerge,
#                             branch_Loop_ContinueUseBodyValue,
#                             phi_Phi_Bug_435621075,
#                             phi_Phi_Propagated_PropagatedPhiValue_BlockParam
#
# One fixture per line, bare name (no .spv).  Comments (#) and blank
# lines ignored.
